More than 300 backends on an instance whose budget is 367 of 397 usable (max_connections 400, 3 reserved; 10 instances x 36 pool + 2 export job + 5 admin). The baseline is two or three. Something is fanning out: a retry storm from the fleet scaling the service up, or transactions that are not ending.

`gcloud run services describe loop-sessions --region=<region> --format='value(status.traffic)'` and the instance-count alert for how many instances are up; `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/num_backends_by_state` in Metrics Explorer for `idle in transaction`, which is a leaked transaction and points at the code path holding it. Through the proxy: `SELECT state, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY 1`.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-cloudsql
